user.title: Yardian (local)
user.description: Connects over your local network only. The access token is shown in the Yardian app.

data_description.host: The controller's IP address on your network. A fixed (reserved) address is best.

reauth_confirm.title: Yardian (local): new access token
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts its access token. It may have been changed in the Yardian app; enter the current one.

reconfigure.title: Yardian (local): change address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the controller's IP address changed. Entities, settings and water totals stay as they are.

data_description.host: The controller's IP address on your network. A fixed (reserved) address is best.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Yardian controller. Add it as a new controller instead.

invalid_auth.message: The controller rejected the access token

bad_response.message: The Yardian controller sent a zone list Home Assistant can't read

start_irrigation.name: Start irrigation
start_irrigation.description: Run a zone for a set time. The controller stops it on its own.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send a notification to each target. Missing or failing targets are skipped, so a notification can never stop watering.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Notify actions, e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel_9. Targets outside the notify domain are skipped.
